Callout.Name: K9 Backup Required
Callout.Message: Handler requesting a K9 unit, suspect fled on foot.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect in a yard, no weapon seen, handler holding the perimeter.

Lines.Approach: He is in the yard and the handler wants a dog rather than a foot chase. Hold what you have.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
